mapper.sql: SELECT la.login_id, la.login_code, u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.employee_no, d.department_nm, pi.item_nm AS position_nm, la.use_at, (la.locked_at IS NOT NULL) AS locked, (u.retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND u.retire_dt <= CURRENT_DATE) AS retired, (la.password_change_required = 'Y') AS password_change_required, to_char(la.password_changed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS password_changed_at, (u.photo_image IS NOT NULL OR la.profile_image IS NOT NULL) AS has_photo FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = la.login_id AND u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id AND d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group pg ON pg.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND pg.group_code = 'POSITION' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item pi ON pi.group_id = pg.common_code_group_id AND pi.item_code = u.position_code
mapper.select:
WHERE la.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND la.use_at = 'Y' AND la.locked_at IS NULL AND NOT (u.retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND u.retire_dt <= CURRENT_DATE)
AND la.use_at = 'N'
AND la.use_at = 'Y' AND la.locked_at IS NOT NULL
AND (u.retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND u.retire_dt <= CURRENT_DATE)
AND ( u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR la.login_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.employee_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.department_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR pi.item_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC NULLS LAST, d.department_nm ASC NULLS LAST, pi.sort_order ASC NULLS LAST, u.employee_no ASC NULLS LAST, la.login_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la.login_id) FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = la.login_id AND u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id JOIN tb_login_account_role lr ON lr.login_id = la.login_id JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = lr.role_id AND r.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE la.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND la.login_id <> #{loginId} AND la.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NOT (u.retire_dt IS NOT NULL AND u.retire_dt <= CURRENT_DATE) AND r.use_at = 'Y' AND r.role_code IN
#{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_login_account_role (login_id, role_id) SELECT #{loginId}, r.role_id FROM tb_role r WHERE r.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.use_at = 'Y' ON CONFLICT (login_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
